_readme: MACHINE-CHECKABLE EVIDENCE. Regenerate with: python3 scripts/verify.py --update
Prose lives in verified-facts.md; THIS file is what scripts/verify.py diffs
the live API against, and what Client reads to warn when it has gone stale.
Never hand-edit `observed_at` — it is a claim about when someone looked.

response_contracts._note: top_level_keys is the exact key SET (stable even when content is not). items_key is where the records live; items_in 'data' means the array is nested under `data` while pagination stays at the ROOT.

pricing._note: credits per record, measured by balance delta. 100000 credits = $1. Re-measure with: python3 scripts/verify.py --pricing (takes ~3 min of settle waits).

qps_ladder._note: Documented at twitterapi.io/qps-limits, not independently measurable. The advertised '200 QPS' is marketing copy; 20 is the observed ceiling.

http_200_body_error.note: failure arrives as HTTP 200 with a body-level status; must be raised, never cached
